title: Telling the Absent from the Slow — Part-Time Legislators Passing Laws
description: Chandra and Toueg's unreliable failure detectors: four part-time legislators in the Chamber of Paxos, an attendance slate at each legislator's bench that may be wrong, and how little they need to get right.
question: A machine that has crashed looks exactly like one that is merely slow, and that alone makes agreement impossible. How well must we tell the absent from the slow before agreement becomes possible again?
how: We find out by exploring how attendance slates kept at each legislator's bench let a rotating presidency pass decrees even when the slates were often wrong.

papers.authors: Tushar Deepak Chandra and Sam Toueg
papers.title: Unreliable Failure Detectors for Reliable Distributed Systems
